# **Student - Computerised Laboratory Systems**

**Sourcing LABS IT**

**Enterprise Platforms****Enterprise IT and Quality****Hillerød, Denmark**

Want to see how technology supports life-changing research and laboratory operations? In this role, you'll help improve processes, support digital solutions, and contribute to projects that make everyday work more efficient. Working alongside experienced professionals, you'll gain valuable insight into IT, compliance, and laboratory environments while developing skills for your future career.

Duration: 6-12 months

Working hours: Up to 8 hours per week

Apply now and start building experience that matters.

## **Your new role**

In this role, you'll gain hands-on experience at the intersection of IT, laboratory operations, and compliance. You'll support the systems and processes that laboratories rely on every day while contributing to projects that improve efficiency, collaboration, and ways of working.

Your main responsibilities will be:

* Supporting compliance and documentation activities related to computerised laboratory systems
* Contributing to projects and continuous improvement initiatives across the team
* Maintaining and enhancing internal websites and SharePoint solutions
* Supporting communication and information management activities
* Identifying opportunities to streamline processes and improve ways of working
* Taking ownership of a smaller project and driving it from idea to implementation

The exact scope of your work will be shaped by your interests, strengths, and development goals, as well as the team's priorities. From day one, you'll contribute to meaningful work, collaborate with a diverse range of stakeholders, and develop valuable experience across IT, compliance, and project management.

## **Your new department**

You'll join the Computerised Laboratory Systems team, where we deliver, qualify, support, and continuously improve the digital solutions used across our laboratories. Our work enables laboratory teams to operate efficiently, securely, and in compliance with applicable requirements.

Working closely with experienced colleagues, you'll gain exposure to the intersection of IT, laboratory operations, and compliance. You'll contribute to a variety of initiatives while collaborating with stakeholders across the organisation and learning how technology supports critical business processes every day.

**Your skills and qualifications**

We're looking for a curious and motivated student who enjoys learning, solving problems, and working with both people and technology. You don't need prior professional experience, but you should be excited about digital solutions and eager to make a meaningful contribution while developing new skills.

You may be studying IT, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Life Sciences, or a related field. We would be particularly interested in candidates who:

* Are structured, reliable, and comfortable taking ownership of their work
* Enjoy solving practical challenges and identifying opportunities for improvement
* Have an interest in digital solutions, IT systems, and process improvement
* Are interested in SharePoint or other collaboration and information management tools
* Communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing
* Bring curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to learn and grow

## **Working at Novo Nordisk**

Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.

## **What we offer**

At Novo Nordisk, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

**Salary and Benefits**: This position is hourly paid. For this position, the hourly base rate is 178,71 DKK, based on an assessment of relevant factors such as experience, educational background, demonstrated competencies, and the specific skills required for the position. In addition to the hourly base rate, Student Assistants are entitled to a pension scheme (currently 10% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution). ​

## **Contact**

For further information about the position, please contact please contact Mads Rudolph Raben at XDRB@novonordisk.com. Please be advised Mads will not support queries about your recruitment status.

##

##

## **Deadline**

October 18th, 2026

Applications will be reviewed, and interviews will take place on an ongoing basis. Therefore, do not hesitate to apply if interested at your earliest convenience.

You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV. To ensure an efficient and fair recruitment process, please refrain from adding a photo to your CV.

We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all applicants.

At Novo Nordisk, we're not chasing quick fixes – we're creating lasting change for long-term health. For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives. This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We embrace diverse perspectives, seek out bold ideas, and build partnerships rooted in shared purpose. Together, we're making healthcare more accessible, treating and preventing diseases, and pioneering solutions that create change spanning generations. When you join us, you become part of something bigger – a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today.

abad46922a62.title: Intern - Global Public Affairs (Early Careers)
abad46922a62.description_md:
Are you a student in the field of business, political science, economics, or international relations and are you passionate about understanding and navigating the interplay between international business and political dynamics? And are you looking for an opportunity to sharpen your skills and apply your theoretical knowledge to real-world global challenges, then the position of Global Public Affairs Intern (Spring Semester 2027) at Maersk might be of interest to you.

**Key Responsibilities**

As a vital member of our Global Public Affairs team, you'll be at the epicentre of where Maersk’s business strategy intersects with geopolitics, policy-shaping, and sustainability. We support all parts of the business on political issues, and we have a global responsibility.

As an intern in Global Public Affairs, you will develop a nuanced understanding of how political, economic, and social shifts shape the future of international trade, infrastructure development, and decarbonization.

You will work with a broad range of tasks, including:

* Work in a clear, structured, and organised manner, with strong attention to detail.
* Engaging in rigorous desk research and analysis to inform our strategic decisions and policy advocacy across the business.
* Develop and implement comprehensive engagement strategies for our top leadership to enhance the company's presence at key global forums such as the UN Climate Change Conferences (COPs), World Economic Forum (WEF) meetings, and regional Climate Weeks.
* Oversee the planning and execution of high-level political visits to Maersk’s headquarters, including coordinating logistics, setting agendas, and briefing senior management.
* Conducting deep-dive analyses into how global political shifts and legislative changes are reshaping the landscape of international trade and affecting Maersk's strategic direction.
* Crafting compelling positions, deepening our strategic frameworks, and supporting engagement plans on a range of political topics.
* Supporting on ad hoc tasks with the potential to embark on special projects with the autonomy to steer your own course, making tangible impacts on our global strategy.

Join us in this exciting role where you will make a significant impact on Maersk's global engagements and strategic initiatives, driving forward our mission to connect and simplify our customers’ supply chains while leading the way in sustainable practices.

**Why Choose Maersk?**

By joining Maersk, you're becoming a part of a pioneering force in integrated logistics, dedicated to improving the quality of life of people by integrating the world. Our Global Public Affairs team is at the forefront of shaping the dialogue on global integration, leveraging our expansive network to champion initiatives that drive meaningful change. As an intern, you'll gain unparalleled insights into the mechanics of global trade and the strategic considerations of a leading multinational and support our climate-journey towards net-zero. As Intern at Maersk, you will also become part of our international student network full of activities and events.

**Who We're Searching For**

We're looking for a structured member of our team with a passion for melding the worlds of business, politics, and environmental sustainability. If you're pursuing a master's degree or studying the last year of your bachelor’s degree in business, political science, economics, international relations, or another relevant field, and possess a keen interest in political, regulatory, and strategic issues with a global scope, we want to hear from you. Your ability to synthesize complex political and business concepts, coupled with your analytical and organizational skills, will set you apart. Proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel, an international perspective, and fluency in English are essential. Bring your ambition and eagerness to learn, and let's make a lasting impact together. Join us for an adventure at our Copenhagen headquarters and leave your mark on the global stage.

The internship is a full-time position (37 hours/week) at our Copenhagen headquarters from February to July . We are, however, flexible to accommodate potential scheduling conflicts and your university credit transfer requirements

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.

 

We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing  [accommodationrequests@maersk.com](mailto:accommodationrequests@maersk.com).

**Global Public Affairs Intern – Supporting Public Affairs for Sub-Saharan Africa (Early Careers)**

Are you a student in business, political science or international relations with a strong interest in how global business operates in complex political environments with a particular focus on Sub-Saharan Africa? Are you eager to apply your academic knowledge to real-world geopolitical and policy challenges? Then the position of Global Public Affairs Intern (Spring Semester 2027) at Maersk may be of interest to you.

**Key Responsibilities**

As part of Maersk’s Global Public Affairs team, you will support the Chief Group Representative for Sub-Saharan Africa, helping to navigate the intersection of business strategy, public policy, and geopolitical developments across the region.

In this role, you will gain insight into how political and economic dynamics shape international trade, logistics infrastructure, and supply chains in emerging markets.
 **Your responsibilities will include:**

* Conducting desk research and political analysis on regulatory, economic, and geopolitical developments across Sub-Saharan Africa.
* Preparing briefings, talking points, and background materials for senior leadership engagements in the region.
* Supporting the planning and coordination of high-level meetings and visits involving African government stakeholders and partners.

This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to Maersk’s engagement in one of the world’s most dynamic and fast-growing regions.

By joining Maersk, you become part of a global leader in integrated logistics, working to connect and simplify supply chains while enabling global trade and sustainable development. Our Global Public Affairs team works at the intersection of business and geopolitics, supporting the company’s strategic priorities worldwide.

As an intern, you will gain valuable insights into how multinational companies engage with governments, international institutions, and policy processes, while developing analytical and professional skills in a truly global environment. You will also become part of Maersk’s international intern network in Copenhagen.

We are looking for a structured and curious student with a strong interest in Africa, international business, and geopolitics.

You have strong analytical and research skills and the ability to translate complex political developments into clear insights for business decision-making.

Experience or academic focus on Africa, emerging markets, or international development will be considered an advantage.

Proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel, fluency in English, and a strong international outlook are essential.

The internship is a full-time position (37 hours/week) at Maersk’s headquarters in Copenhagen from February to July. We are flexible in accommodating university requirements such as credit transfers.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Talent Acquisition Intern to support our Global Functions Talent Acquisition team in Copenhagen starting January 2027. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience across multiple areas of Talent Acquisition, including internal mobility, sourcing, recruitment operations, process improvement, and stakeholder engagement.

As a Talent Acquisition Intern, you will partner closely with Talent Acquisition Partners, Talent Acquisition Operations, hiring managers, and Global Mobility teams to help deliver an exceptional employee and candidate experience while supporting efficient and compliant hiring processes.

This internship is intended for students currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's programme in a Danish University who are able to receive ECTS credits as a part of their studies

**Key Responsibilities**

**Internal Relocations & Mobility Support**

* Support the coordination of internal employee relocation cases.
* Coordinate offer letters and supporting documentation.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition Operations and Global Mobility teams to ensure smooth processing of relocation cases.
* Support relocating employees and managers throughout the process, providing guidance and timely communication.

**Talent Sourcing & Pipeline Development**

* Support Talent Acquisition Partners with candidate sourcing activities.
* Conduct targeted talent searches through LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing platforms.
* Research talent markets and identify potential candidate pools.
* Support diversity sourcing initiatives and proactive talent mapping activities.

**Documentation & Process Excellence**

* Organize and maintain Talent Acquisition documentation, templates, process guides, and knowledge articles.
* Review documentation regularly to ensure policies, processes, and best practices remain current and easily accessible.
* Support process improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to increase efficiency and standardization.

**Reporting & Insights**

* Support the preparation of recruitment and sourcing reports.
* Track key Talent Acquisition metrics and data trends.
* Assist with data validation and quality checks.

**Team & Project Support**

* Participate in Talent Acquisition team meetings and projects.
* Support Early Careers and recruitment events where applicable.
* Contribute to special Talent Acquisition projects and continuous improvement initiatives.

**What We're Looking For**

**Qualifications**

* Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Communications, Social Sciences or a related field at a Danish University
* Strong interest in Talent Acquisition, Human Resources, and talent management.
* Experience with LinkedIn or other sourcing platforms is an advantage.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.
* Strong problem-solving mindset and willingness to learn.
* Comfortable working with data, systems, and process documentation.
* Collaborative, proactive, and customer-focused approach.
* High level of professionalism and discretion when handling confidential information.

**What You'll Gain**

* Hands-on exposure to a global Talent Acquisition function.
* Experience working with Talent Acquisition, Global Mobility, and HR stakeholders.
* Training on recruitment systems, sourcing tools, and talent market research.
* Opportunities to contribute to process improvement and strategic TA initiatives
* Mentorship and development from experienced Talent Acquisition professionals

199ce6eafa33.title: Student Analyst i Family Office
199ce6eafa33.description_md:
Vi søger en ambitiøs **studentermedhjælper til Danske Banks Family Office-team**. Du får base på vores nye hovedkontor på **Bernstorffsgade, København**, og bliver en del af et dynamisk miljø med kolleger fra hele banken. 

Som student hos os bliver du en integreret del af teamet og får en bred eksponering mod de mange forskellige opgaver, der ligger i et family office-samarbejde. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med bankers og specialister på tværs af banken og får indblik i, hvordan vi forbereder analyser, kundedialog og løsninger for danske familier samt single- og multi-family offices. 

Rollen er tilrettelagt som en læringsplatform: Du vil bidrage på tværs af analyse, research, mødeforberedelse, kundemateriale og interne projekter. Opgaverne varierer, og du får mulighed for at opbygge en bred finansiel værktøjskasse, før du gradvist tager ansvar for mere komplekse leverancer. 

 

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med: 

* Analyse af investeringer, porteføljer og aktivallokering
* Regnskabsanalyse samt vurdering af finansierings- og kreditforhold
* Research inden for private equity, private credit og øvrige alternative investeringer
* Udarbejdelse af kundemateriale, præsentationer og pitches samt deltagelse, når det er relevant
* Projekter på tværs af Asset Management, Markets, Corporate Finance, Credit Advisory og Private Banking
* Deltagelse i strategiske projekter og udvikling af nye initiativer for Family Office-kunder

 

Hvem er du? 

Vi forestiller os, at du læser en finansielt eller økonomisk orienteret uddannelse på CBS, KU eller et andet relevant universitet – eksempelvis FIR, FIN, FSM, AEF, cand.polit. eller tilsvarende. Du er gerne i gang med din kandidatuddannelse, men det er ikke et krav. 

Vi forestiller os, at du: 

* Har stor interesse for investeringer, virksomheder og finansielle markeder
* Er analytisk stærk og har erfaring med regnskaber og finansiel modellering
* Arbejder struktureret og har sans for både detaljen og den samlede historie
* Er nysgerrig, proaktiv og ikke bange for at stille spørgsmål
* Har lyst til at tage ansvar og bidrage med egne idéer
* Er stærk i Excel og PowerPoint
* Er flittig bruger af AI, men forstår at forholde sig kritisk til outputtet
* Kommunikerer klart på dansk og engelsk

Erfaring fra et tidligere studiejob eller internship inden for eksempelvis corporate finance, revision, asset management, private equity eller banking er en fordel – men ikke et krav. Motivation, faglig nysgerrighed og viljen til at udvikle sig vægter mindst lige så højt. 

 

Hvad får du hos os? 

Du får en stejl læringskurve og en bred finansiel værktøjskasse, som normalt kræver flere forskellige roller at opbygge. Du får tæt sparring, indblik i reelle kundeopgaver og et stærkt netværk på tværs af banken. 

Vi forventer, at du bidrager aktivt. Til gengæld investerer vi i din udvikling og giver dig mere ansvar, efterhånden som du er klar til det. 

**Lyder det som det rette studiejob for dig?** 

* **Forventet opstart:**Hurtigst muligt

 
Vedlæg dit **CV og karakterblad**, og send en personlig ansøgning, der giver os et indtryk af, hvem du er – ud over dit CV. Du bestemmer selv formen og må meget gerne være kreativ. Du kan eksempelvis fortælle om dine interesseområder, et projekt du har arbejdet med og fandt særligt spændende, et fag eller valgfag der gjorde indtryk på dig, hvad du bruger din fritid på, hvad der driver og motiverer dig, et citat du finder særligt interessant eller en film, der har gjort indtryk på dig. Du er også meget velkommen til at tage noget helt andet med, hvis det siger noget relevant om dig, din nysgerrighed og den måde, du vil bidrage til teamet og udvikle dig i rollen på. 

Har du spørgsmål? Kontakt **Mattias Wulff Andersen,**First-Year Analyst, på **+45 29 39 38 09.** 

**Ansøg nu og bliv en del af et team, der arbejder med nogle af de mest spændende kunder og komplekse løsninger i banken!**

We are looking for **two Student Assistants** to join our **Strategic Sourcing team**, supporting procurement and category management activities across our organisation.

This is an opportunity to work alongside experienced procurement professionals, gain exposure to strategic sourcing activities, and develop practical skills that are highly relevant for a future career within procurement, contract management, legal, consultancy, or commercial management.

**What you will be doing**

You will support our Procurement and Category Managers with a variety of operational and administrative activities, including:

* Data registration and maintenance in procurement systems
* Quality assurance of sourcing and contract documentation
* Preparation of documents for review and signature
* Market and supplier benchmarking activities
* Collection, consolidation, and analysis of procurement data
* Coordination and follow-up on procurement activities and stakeholder requests

As you grow into the role, you will also be expected to independently manage low-complexity IT contracts from initial request through negotiation, stakeholder alignment, and signature, with support and coaching from experienced colleagues.

**What we are looking for**

We imagine that you:

* Are currently studying for a relevant master's degree
* Ideally have recently started your **cand.merc.jur.** studies (first year preferred), although students from other relevant programmes are also welcome to apply
* Have strong attention to detail and enjoy working with data and documentation
* Are structured, reliable, and able to manage multiple tasks simultaneously
* Have strong written and verbal communication skills in English
* Have a positive and proactive mindset and are willing to learn

Most importantly, you are curious, willing to be accountable, and motivated by working in a collaborative environment where you can develop professionally.

**What we offer**

You will join a Strategic Sourcing team that thrives in a dynamic environment. While we work with challenging goals, we also place great value on teamwork, humor, mutual respect, and maintaining a positive atmosphere.

You can expect:

* Exposure to strategic sourcing and procurement
* Practical experience with commercial and contractual processes
* Opportunities to work with stakeholders across the organization
* Significant responsibility and room for personal development
* Close collaboration with experienced procurement professionals
* A supportive team culture where learning and knowledge sharing are an integral part of daily work

This position offers a unique opportunity to build relevant commercial, legal, and procurement capabilities while learning directly from senior specialists and leaders within the field.

**Interested?**

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you.

I Securities Withholding Tax arbejder vi blandt andet med udbytteskat, refusion af udbytteskat, kildereduktionsservice, dokumentationskrav, dobbeltbeskatningsoverenskomster og skattemæssigt hjemsted på tværs af markeder og kundesegmenter. Vores arbejde bidrager til, at kunder bliver beskattet retmæssigt i forbindelse med investeringer, og at relevante dokumentations- og proceskrav bliver håndteret fyldestgørende.

Som praktikant bliver du en del af Danske Banks faglige og professionelle miljø, hvor du får mulighed for at lære af erfarne kolleger og få indblik i, hvordan en stor finansiel organisation arbejder med skatterelaterede processer.

**Din rolle og dine ansvarsområder**

Som praktikant i Securities Withholding Tax Services vil du bidrage til teamets daglige opgaver og få indblik i, hvordan Danske Bank arbejder med beskatning af udbytter fra investeringer.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

* Understøtte administrative og operationelle opgaver i teamet
* Assistere med opfølgning på processer for refusion af udbytteskat
* Hjælpe med administration af kildereduktionsservice
* Bidrage til at sikre korrekt dokumentation i forbindelse med udbytteskat
* Vedligeholde og opdatere information i interne systemer
* Hjælpe med rapportering og opfølgning på åbne sager om refusion af udbytteskat
* Assistere med kontroller, fejlidentifikation og eskalering til relevante kolleger
* Bidrage til korrekt håndtering af skatterelaterede processer
* Være i dialog med kunder, rådgivere og interne interessenter for at indhente nødvendig dokumentation og information
* Bidrage til løbende forbedringer af processer og arbejdsgange

**Om dig**

Vi søger en motiveret og åben person med interesse for skat, retmæssig beskatning og finansielle investeringer. Du får en god mulighed for at styrke dine kompetencer og få værdifuld indsigt i, hvordan en stor finansiel organisation arbejder med udbytteskat, herunder refusion af udbytteskat, kildereduktionsservice og internationale skatteprocesser.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

* Er i gang med en bacheloruddannelse i skat på Københavns Professionshøjskole eller tilsvarende
* Er tilgængelig for praktik fra februar 2027 til juni 2027
* Har interesse for udbytteskat, refusion af udbytteskat, retmæssig beskatning, dokumentation, dobbeltbeskatningsoverenskomster, skattemæssigt hjemsted og operationelle processer
* Kan kommunikere professionelt på engelsk og dansk, både skriftligt og mundtligt
* Er nysgerrig og har lyst til at lære
* Er en stærk holdspiller
* Arbejder struktureret og har øje for detaljer

**Vi tilbyder**

Som praktikant i Danske Bank får du:

* Praktisk erfaring fra en stor finansiel organisation
* Indsigt i, hvordan Danske Bank håndterer beskatning af udbytter fra kunders investeringer
* Mulighed for at lære af erfarne og specialiserede kolleger
* Et professionelt og støttende teammiljø
* Erfaring med samarbejde på tværs af Danske Bank og med kolleger i Danmark og Litauen
* Mulighed for at bidrage til konkrete opgaver og løbende forbedringer

**Praktiske oplysninger og kontakt**

Praktikken foregår i Danske Banks domicil i Postbyen, København.

Praktikken er ulønnet.

Søg stillingen ved at sende dit CV, din ansøgning og dokumentation for, at du er indskrevet på uddannelsen.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen eller praktikforløbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte: Assad Ullah, [asull@danskebank.dk](mailto:asull@danskebank.dk)

dd1c049ec5db.title: Aspiring Software Developer - Student Position
dd1c049ec5db.description_md:
Are you curious about modern software development and looking for your next challenge? At Deloitte Engineering, we are seeking motivated **part-time student helpers** who want to take an active role in improving their technical and problem-solving competencies while growing our Engineering practice.

With more than 2.700 employees Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. We tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services, and Consulting.

**About the team**

We, the Engineering offering of Deloitte Technology & Transformation Denmark, are on the lookout for additional team-players for our quickly growing practice of software engineers, cloud consultants, and IT management consultants. We assist our clients, some of the largest companies, agencies, and organizations in Denmark and the Nordics, on the implementation of new cloud-native systems as part of their digital transformation – and we need you to help build their opportunities and meet their challenges!

Together, we will accelerate your career towards becoming a proficient software engineer and enable a smooth transition to a potential full-time position after your studies. At Deloitte, we are committed to empowering you throughout your career development. As a new employee, you are assigned a talent manager to support your career aspirations and development. You will also be part of a tech community with monthly meetings in which we share knowledge, investigate new topics, and upskill within relevant technologies and methodologies.

As a student worker at the Engineering offering, you will be supporting experienced developers on many different projects. To thrive in our team, you embrace working with varying tech-stacks and different aspects of development. Our client assignments can vary greatly, but common for all of them are that we strive to work with the technologies that the client prefers. Regardless of the technology, we provide you with the opportunity and tools needed to learn and grow within all of them.

**In this role, you will make an impact by:**

* Developing applications and solutions of all sizes, frequently in Agile settings (SAFE/Scrum). This includes both backend and frontend development, often directed towards public clouds or on-premises.
* Enabling DevOps through development of CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code.
* Building internal capabilities through community tasks, maybe within new business areas.
* Joining in on workshops and sales pitches and contributing to proposals for new client projects.

You are a Master's student at the top of your class, preferably within Computer Science, Engineering, or similar with at least one year of studies left and the energy to work 15-20 hours per week with us. Furthermore, you are either a native Danish speaker or highly proficient in written and spoken Danish.

**What you bring to the team:**

* Programming-wise, you have experience with either Java, C#/.Net, Python, C, C++, GO, Clojure or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* You have strong analytical skills and a focus on quality and detail.
* You are a positive-minded teammate with the ability to work and solve problems in a structured way.
* You can communicate and express yourself clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing.

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

**What we can offer you**

We highly appreciate the knowledge, experience, and perspectives our consultants bring, and in exchange, we make sure they develop professionally, meet their career goals, and enjoy their time with Deloitte. Therefore, other than an incredible social calendar, we offer our consultants:

* Enrolment in the Consultant Academy, which is our training program for building the essential Consultant skills. The Academy takes you to exciting locations to learn from leading professionals in their respective fields.
* Focused career development by assigning you a talent manager who acts as your mentor and guides you in your professional journey in Deloitte.
* The opportunity to participate in projects and internal work with our different market offerings to find the right fit for you.

On the social aspect, Deloitte Technology & Transformation is second to none. We offer everything from various sports communities to festivals – not to mention the yearly Trip where all our colleagues come together off-site to create lasting memories. Additionally, we have a strong sense of belonging and community in Engineering, and we support each other every day to make an impact with our clients and to promote personal and professional development.

**Do you want to be part of our team?**

Send your application, CV, and other relevant documents before the 1st of November, 2026. We process applications and arrange interviews continually, so we recommend that you apply as soon as possible.

Expected start date: Before or 1st of January, 2027

Please do not hesitate to contact **Sophus Benee Olsen** at **soolsen@deloitte.dk** if you have any questions about the position.

**Disclosure on the Use of AI:** We want to ensure that all applicants receive fair treatment in our recruitment process. This role is part of a pilot where we are testing an innovative approach to recruitment using AI, and therefore you should not upload a traditional cover letter. We want to be completely transparent about the pilot – Read more [here](https://c.smartrecruiters.com/sr-company-attachments-prod-aws-dc5/63e274c1fce4e3117912f313/584e10b3-30ab-4da3-8cb8-4663d03c219e?r=s3-eu-central-1).

At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team´s success.

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position regardless of, e.g., age, gender (gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

By applying for this job, you will be assessed against the Deloitte Global Talent Standards. We have designed these standards to provide a consistent and exceptional Deloitte employee experience globally.

*In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.*

Med vores mere end 2700 ansatte er Deloitte Danmarks største revisions- og rådgivningshus. Vi skræddersyer løsninger på tværs af revision, skat, finansiel rådgivning, enterprise risk services og rådgivning.

*Leder du efter et studiejob og læser du en bachelor inden for økonomi, finans, data eller noget fjerde relevant? Så er det dig, vi søger lige nu.*

Er du nysgerrig på, hvordan det er at arbejde i revision? Eller drømmer du om at blive revisor, når du er færdig med studierne? Så er du en af de studentermedhjælpere, vi søger i København.

I Audit & Assurance er vi på udkig efter dygtige studentermedhjælpere til arbejde inden for revision. Vi leder efter dig, der vil:

* Arbejde med kunder, der kan spænde fra små selvstændige virksomheder til store børsnoterede selskaber.
* Have bred indsigt i regnskab og revisionspraksis ved at assistere med diverse opgaver, der kan rumme alt fra planlægning, udførsel og afslutning af revisionsopgaver, kundebetjening, kundebesøg og lagerkontrol.
* Oparbejde kendskab til forskellige industriers revisionsudfordringer og omsætte den teori, du har lært på studiet.

Rollen som studentermedhjælper er en naturlig indgangsvinkel til en graduatestilling i vores revisionsforretning. Derfor er vi især på udkig efter dig, som har interesse for at blive fastansat som graduate efter studierne. Hos os kan du nemlig blive graduate allerede efter din bachelor og læse din kandidat på deltid som en del af dit graduatejob. Du kan læse mere om graduatestillingen [her](https://www.deloitte.com/dk/en/careers/discover-your-path/bliv-revisortrainee-eller-revisor-graduate-audit.html?icid=top_bliv-revisortrainee-eller-revisor-graduate-audit).

Vi forestiller os, at du studerer på en erhvervsøkonomisk (HA) uddannelse og er et par semestre inde. Derudover håber vi, at du er:

* God til at skabe relationer og møde kunden med en positiv indstilling og nysgerrighed.
* En teamplayer, der naturligt tager ansvar – både for egen læring og ved at søge råd hos dine kolleger.
* Interesseret i regnskab og økonomi og klar til at tage ansvar for vores kunder.

**Klik på ”jeg er interesseret” ovenfor for at søge jobbet.**

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi finder de rette kandidater. Vi vil gerne se dit CV og karakterer fra din bachelor og kandidat og derudover beder vi dig i ansøgningsprocessen om at besvare et par spørgsmål. Derfor bedes du undlade at uploade en traditionel motiveret ansøgning.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller ansættelsesprocessen, så kontakt venligst Recruitment Coordinator Emil Morelli Nørgaard på mobil: +45 53793260 eller mail: talent@deloitte.dk

Vi opfordrer alle kandidater til at søge stillingen, uanset alder, køn (kønsidentitet eller kønsudtryk), seksuel orientering, religion, etnicitet, nationalitet eller handicap.

bf2922f3daba.title: Start your career as an Audit Graduate at Deloitte Copenhagen 2027
bf2922f3daba.description_md:
With more than 2700 employees Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. We tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services, and Consulting.

**Would you like to start your audit career at Deloitte's head office?**

At our Copenhagen office you will get 600 Audit & Assurance colleagues across departments. We have a strong sense of community, with many joint events, from Friday bars to courses and development opportunities. This gives you plenty of opportunity to build a strong network and a foundation for where your career at Deloitte will take you.

As an audit graduate, your day-to-day work will take place in either our Portfolio or Large & Complex departments. You will be assigned to one of our four client segments: Public, Private, Financial Services, or Top Tier and your daily work will be team-based. You will have a dedicated department manager and a coach to support your personal and professional development.

You will quickly become part of your new community and have ample opportunity to build new relationships.

**As an audit graduate you:**

* Always work in audit teams and be in close contact with both colleagues and clients - often working on site at the client's premises.
* Acquire extensive knowledge of your department's clients and, most importantly, the skills to advise and audit them.
* Assist in planning client's audits, coordinating efforts with, for example, Deloitte's Service and Delivery Centres, which handle many of our administrative tasks, ahead of the reporting season.
* Contribute to risk assessments of accounting areas, using your knowledge of the client's internal processes.
* Work with an experienced audit team to conduct audits to ensure that the financial statements give a true and fair view.

Your role will vary depending on which department you join but we promise that your days will not be the same. There will be room to learn, to ask for help, and to grow and take on the responsibility you want.

**NEXT - our graduate development programme**

When you join as an audit graduate, you enter a full-time role and will join our internal development programme, NEXT, along with around 100 other graduates across the country. You are regularly brought together for training and to prepare for new roles.

Depending on where you are in your training when you join us, you will also be studying part-time at the university. And for your first 100 days with us, you will be assigned a buddy who has been through the experience of being a new graduate and will help you settle into your new role.

There are several paths to become an audit graduate in our audit business. We are open to your educational background and to you completing a level of training while you are with us. The most important thing is that you have the interest and motivation to learn. And it is important that you:

* Want to develop personally.
* Are curious about auditing.
* Have social skills that will support your future relationships with clients and colleagues, and team-based working.
* Can show relevant professional experience or extra curricular activities , in which you have excelled.
* You speak and understand both English and Danish, or any of the other Nordic languages.
* You are eligible to work within the EU, either as a citizen or with the correct permits.

At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team´s success.

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

**Click on "I am interested" above to apply for this position.**

Please attach your CV and grades from your current and previous education. Please do not upload a traditional cover letter. Through the application process we will also ask you to answer a few questions about your motivation for the joining Deloitte.

We process applications and arrange interviews continually.

**Expected start date to be 10.09.2027**.

If you have any questions about the position or the recruitment process, please contact Recruitment Coordinator Emil Morelli Nørgaard on mobile: +45 53793260 or email: [talent@deloitte.dk](mailto:talent@deloitte.dk)

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position regardless of, e.g., age, gender (gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

**We look forward to hearing from you!**

3c3bc54ef082.title: Bliv revisor graduate i 2027 hos Deloitte København
3c3bc54ef082.description_md:
Deloitte er Danmarks førende rådgivnings- og revisionshus. Vores revisionsforretning, Audit & Assurance, består af 750 medarbejdere fordelt på to kontorer i Danmark. Hos os kan du skræddersy din udvikling inden for utallige fagområder, roller, kundetyper og opgaver. Stillingen giver dig mulighed for at kombinere et fuldtidsarbejde inden for økonomi, rådgivning og den nyeste teknologi med uddannelse og personlig udvikling.

**Vil du starte din revisionskarriere på Deloittes hovedkontor?**

På vores kontor i København sidder vi 600 medarbejdere i Audit og Assurance på tværs af afdelinger og industrier, men til dagligt arbejder vi i mindre teams, så du får en tæt relation til dine kolleger. Vi har et godt sammenhold, udvikling på tværs og masser af fælles arrangementer fra fredagsbar til kurser. Så du får rig mulighed for at skabe et godt netværk og et stærkt fundament for, hvor din karriere i Deloitte skal bevæge sig hen.

Som revisorgraduate, vil din hverdag enten foregå i vores Portfolio- eller Large & Complex-afdeling. Her vil du blive tilknyttet ét af vores fire kundesegmenter: Public, Private, Financial Services eller Top Tier. Du vil få en fast afdelingsleder samt en coach, som du kan bruge til støtte i din personlige og professionelle udvikling.

Det er altså rimelig sikkert, at du hurtigt vil blive en del af dit nye fællesskab og får rig mulighed for at skabe nye relationer.

**I rollen som revisorgraduate vil du bl.a.**:

* Altid arbejde i kundeteams og være i tæt kontakt med både kolleger og kunder – ofte foregår arbejdet ude hos kunden.
* Tilegne dig stor viden om din afdelings kunder – og ikke mindst dygtiggøre dig i at rådgive og revidere dem.
* Deltage i planlægningen af revisioner, koordinere indsatser med fx Deloitte service- og delivery centre, som løser mange af vores administrative opgaver forud for statussæsonen.
* Bidrage til at udføre risikovurderinger af regnskabsområder, hvor du sætter din viden om kundens interne processer i spil.
* Udføre status sammen med et erfarent revisionsteam, som sikrer, at årsregnskabet giver et retvisende billede.

Dine opgaver vil selvfølgelig variere alt efter i hvilken afdeling, du får din daglige gang. Men vi lover dig, at dagene ikke bliver ensformige. Der vil være plads til at lære, spørge om hjælp og ikke mindst vokse og tage det ansvar, som du har lyst til.

**NEXT - vores udviklingsprogram for revisorgraduates**

Som revisorgraduate, starter du i en fuldtidsstilling og bliver tilknyttet vores interne udviklingsprogram NEXT sammen med ca. 100 andre nye graduates landet over, som løbende samles til undervisning og klædes på til nye opgaver.

Alt efter hvor du er i din uddannelse, når du starter hos os, vil du også følge et deltidsstudie på universitetet ved siden af. Du vil blive tilknyttet en buddy de første 100 dage du er hos os, som selv har prøvet at være ny trainee eller graduate, og som skal hjælpe dig godt ombord i din nye rolle.

Vi forestiller os, at du læser en HA-bachelor, cand.merc.aud eller en anden finansiel uddannelse. Vi er altid åbne for interessante indgangsveje, og for at du kan færdiggøre et uddannelsesniveau, mens du er hos os. Det vigtigste er, at du kommer med en oprigtig interesse i revision samt en motivation for at lære. Og så er det vigtigt, at du:

* Vil udvikle dig personligt.
* Er nysgerrig på det faglige revisionsarbejde.
* Besidder sociale evner, der understøtter dine fremtidige kunderelationer og i samarbejdet med dine kolleger.
* Har gjort dig relevante erfaringer enten professionelt eller i din fritid, hvor du har udmærket dig.
* Du kan forstå og tale engelsk og dansk.
* Du har arbejdstilladelse i Danmark.

Hos Deloitte værdsætter vi forskellige kompetencer, perspektiver og erfaringer, da det gør os i stand til effektivt at løse komplekse udfordringer for vores klienter. Vi opfordrer dig til at søge stillingen, hvis du mener, at dine kompetencer kan bidrage til vores teams succes.

Selv hvis du ikke umiddelbart genkender dig selv i alle de beskrevne kvalifikationer, ønsker vi stadig at opfordre dig til at søgestillingen, hvis du mener, at dine kompetencer kan bidrage positivt til vores team.

**Klik på ”jeg er interesseret” ovenfor for at søge stillingen.**

 Vi vil gerne se dit CV og karakterer fra din nuværende og forrige uddannelse, derudover beder vi dig i ansøgningsprocessen om at besvare et par spørgsmål. Derfor bedes du undlade at uploade en traditionel motiveret ansøgning.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og **forventer opstart 10.09.2027.**

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller ansættelsesprocessen, så kontakt venligst Recruitment Coordinator Emil Morelli Nørgaard på mobil: +45 53793260 eller mail [talent@deloitte.dk](mailto:talent@deloitte.dk?subject=Sp%C3%B8rgsm%C3%A5l%20til%20stillingen%20som%20revisorgraduate%202025)

Vi opfordrer alle kandidater til at søge stillingen, uanset alder, køn (kønsidentitet eller kønsudtryk), seksuel orientering, religion, etnicitet, nationalitet eller handicap.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

*In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.*

Advisory

Not Applicable

**Job Description & Summary**

**Kunne du tænke dig at arbejde med økonomistyring, transformation og performance management i nogle af Danmarks største virksomheder? Vil du være med til at løse komplekse problemstillinger tæt på CFO'en og få ansvar fra dag ét?** 
Så bliv graduate i PwC's Finance Excellence og kickstart din karriere som konsulent!

I Finance Excellence hjælper vi virksomheder med at skabe bedre beslutningsgrundlag, stærkere økonomifunktioner og mere effektive processer. Som graduate bliver du en del af et stærkt fagligt miljø, hvor du får mulighed for at arbejde med både drift, udvikling og transformation af finansfunktionen hos vores kunder.

**Vi sætter dig i førerposition fra starten**

Den 1. september 2027 starter dit graduate-forløb i Finance Excellence, når du slutter dig til vores afdeling og et stærkt hold af gode kolleger med forskellige baggrunde inden for økonomi, finans, regnskab og forretningsudvikling. Du bliver fastansat i afdelingen og gennem de næste to år bliver du klædt på til rollen som konsulent gennem praktisk erfaring, sparring med erfarne kolleger og et skræddersyet udviklingsforløb.

Derudover får du din egen career coach, som støtter din faglige og personlige udvikling gennem graduateforløbet og videre i din karriere hos PwC.

**Bliv en del af Finance Excellence i Consulting**

Finance Excellence samler PwC's kompetencer inden for CFO-rådgivning og CFO-services. Fælles for vores arbejde er, at vi hjælper virksomheder med at udvikle, styrke og drive deres økonomifunktioner.

Som graduate får du mulighed for at arbejde tæt sammen med nogle af markedets dygtigste specialister og rådgive virksomheder om alt fra daglig økonomistyring og controlling til større transformationsprogrammer og implementering af nye styringsmodeller.

”*I Finance Excellence er der stor fokus på din faglige og personlige udvikling, hvilket understøttes af en stor variation af arbejdsopgaver, diverse kurser og sociale arrangementer. Overgangen fra studerende til fuldtidsansat gik overraskende nemt pga. det unge miljø i afdelingen*," fortæller Jonas, der er tidligere graduate hos PwC i Hellerup.

Afhængigt af hvilket spor du vælger, vil du enten arbejde som en integreret del af kundens organisation eller som rådgiver på strategiske og transformationstunge projekter.

**Vælg dit spor: CFO Service, CFO Service Payroll eller CFO Advisory**

Når du søger graduateprogrammet, skal du i din ansøgning angive, hvilket af nedenstående områder du ønsker at blive en del af.

* **CFO Service:** Som graduate i CFO Service arbejder du på interim basis ude hos kunder. Du træder ind som en konsulent, når kunden har brug for ekstra kapacitet eller specialiserede kompetencer, og du bliver hurtigt en integreret del af organisationen. Du får praktisk erfaring med blandt andet økonomistyring, controlling, rapportering, procesoptimering og projektarbejde og udvikler dermed en stærk faglig værktøjskasse. Samtidig lærer du at forstå virksomheden indefra, identificere forbedringsmuligheder og omsætte dine analyser til konkrete løsninger, som implementeres i tæt samarbejde med kunden.
* **CFO Service Payroll:** Som graduate i CFO Service Payroll arbejder du primært på interim basis ude hos kunder. Du vil arbejde i spændingsfeltet mellem HR og Finans – og med fokus på at blive specialist inden for lønområdet. Du vil komme til at træde ind som konsulent hos kunderne, når der er behov for ekstra ressourcer eller specifikke kompetencer indenfor payroll efterspørges. Du vil få praktisk erfaring med blandt andet lønadministration, controlling, design og optimering af processer samt projektarbejde. Fokus vil være på specialisering inden for et område, hvor udvikling fra operationel funktion til sparringspartner sker hurtigt.
* **CFO Advisory:** Som graduate i CFO Advisory bliver du en del af projekthold, der rådgiver virksomheder om, hvordan de udvikler fremtidens økonomifunktion. Du kommer til at hjælpe kunder med blandt andet operating models, styringsmodeller, planlægningsprocesser, performance management og implementering af nye løsninger. Her er fokus på analyse, transformation og strategisk rådgivning.

**Et stærkt fællesskab og gode kolleger, der bliver nye venner**

I Finance Excellence kombinerer vi høj faglighed med et stærkt fællesskab. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem samarbejde, sparring og videndeling.

Du får ansvar tidligt i din karriere, men står aldrig alene. Uanset om du arbejder ude hos kunder eller på interne projekter, vil du altid have erfarne kolleger omkring dig, som hjælper dig med at udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt.

Samtidigt bliver du en del af PwC's graduatefællesskab på tværs af huset, hvor du deltager i onboarding, netværksaktiviteter og faglige udviklingsforløb sammen med de øvrige graduates.

**Er du ved at afslutte din kandidat og klar til næste skridt?**

Så længe du (snart) har en kandidat inden for regnskab, økonomi, finans eller lignende og er klar på at lære en masse, klæder vi dig godt på til resten. Din nysgerrighed og lyst til at tilegne dig viden, forventes at være din største drivkraft. Men det er også vigtigt, at du har lyst til at opbygge relationer og er en teamplayer, der ser opgaveløsningen som en holdindsats.

**Klar til at kickstarte din karriere?**

... så ansøg via linket og husk at angive om du søger CFO Service eller CFO Advisory. Du finder svar på de mest almindelige spørgsmål i vores [FAQ](http://www.pwc.dk/graduates#faq).

Finder du ikke et svar på dit spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Talent Attraction Advisor Natasha Berthelsen på natasha.berthelsen@pwc.com.

Deadline er 18. oktober, og samtaler er planlagt i november.

* Upload CV

**Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!**

# Become a Graduate in PwC's Finance Excellence and Step Into the Role of Advisor to Tomorrow's CFOs

**Would you like to work with financial management, transformation, and performance management in some of Denmark's largest companies? Do you want to help solve complex business challenges close to the CFO and take on responsibility from day one?**

Then join PwC's Finance Excellence graduate programme and kickstart your career as a consultant!

In Finance Excellence, we help companies build stronger foundations for decision-making, more effective finance functions, and streamlined processes. As a graduate, you will become part of a highly professional environment where you will have the opportunity to work with both the operation, development, and transformation of our clients' finance functions.

**Take the Lead From Day One**

On 1 September 2027, you will begin your graduate journey in Finance Excellence, joining our team of talented colleagues with diverse backgrounds in accounting, finance, economics, and business development.

You will be permanently employed in the department and, over the next two years, be prepared for a consulting career through hands-on experience, sparring with experienced colleagues, and a tailored development programme.

In addition, you will be assigned your own Career Coach, who will support your professional and personal development throughout the graduate programme and beyond as your career progresses at PwC.

**Join Finance Excellence in Consulting**

Finance Excellence brings together PwC's expertise in CFO Advisory and CFO Services. What unites our work is helping organisations develop, strengthen, and operate their finance functions.

As a graduate, you will have the opportunity to work closely with some of the market's leading specialists and advise clients on everything from day-to-day financial management and controlling to large-scale transformation programmes and the implementation of new performance management frameworks.

"*In Finance Excellence, there is a strong focus on both professional and personal development, supported by a wide variety of assignments, training courses, and social events. The transition from student to full-time employee was surprisingly smooth thanks to the young and welcoming environment in the department,"* says Jonas, a former graduate at PwC in Hellerup.

Depending on the track you choose, you will either work as an integrated part of a client's organisation or as an advisor on strategic and transformation-focused projects.

**Choose Your Track: CFO Service or CFO Advisory**

When applying for the graduate programme, please indicate in your application which of the following areas you would like to join.

* CFO Service: As a graduate in CFO Service, you will work on an interim basis at client organisations. You will step in as a consultant when clients need additional capacity or specialised expertise and quickly become an integrated part of their organisation. You will gain hands-on experience within financial management, controlling, reporting, process optimisation, and project management, building a strong professional toolbox in the process. At the same time, you will learn to understand businesses from the inside, identify improvement opportunities, and turn your analyses into tangible solutions that are implemented in close collaboration with the client.
* CFO Service Payroll: As a graduate in CFO Service Payroll, you will primarily work on an interim basis at client organizations. You’ll operate at the intersection of HR and Finance, with a strong focus on becoming a specialist in payroll. You will step in as a consultant for clients when there is a need for additional resources or specific competencies within payroll. You will gain hands on experience within payroll administration, controlling, process design and optimization, as well as project work. The focus will be on specializing in an area that quickly evolves from an operational function to a sparring partner in the market we see ahead.
* CFO Advisory: As a graduate in CFO Advisory, you will join project teams that advise organisations on how to build and develop the finance function of the future. You will support clients with areas such as operating models, governance frameworks, planning processes, performance management, and the implementation of new solutions. The focus is on analysis, transformation, and strategic advisory services.

**A Strong Community and Great Colleagues Who Become Friends**

At Finance Excellence, we combine professional excellence with a strong sense of community. We believe the best results are achieved through collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous sparring.

You will take on responsibility early in your career, but you will never stand alone. Whether you are working on-site with clients or on internal projects, you will always be surrounded by experienced colleagues who are committed to helping you grow both professionally and personally.

At the same time, you will become part of PwC's graduate community across the firm, participating in onboarding activities, networking events, and development programmes alongside fellow graduates.

**Are You Finishing Your Master's Degree and Ready for the Next Step?**

As long as you have, or will soon obtain, a Master's degree in accounting, economics, finance, or a related field, and are eager to learn, we will provide you with the tools you need to succeed.

Your curiosity and desire to continuously expand your knowledge are expected to be your strongest drivers. Equally important is your ability to build relationships and your mindset as a team player who sees solving client challenges as a collective effort.

**Ready to Kickstart Your Career?**

Apply via the link and remember to indicate whether you are applying for CFO Service or CFO Advisory. If you have any questions, please contact Talent Attraction Advisor Natasha Berthelsen at natasha.berthelsen@pwc.com.

The application deadline is 18 October, and interviews are scheduled to take place in November.

Du kan derfor glæde dig til at komme omkring et væld af forskellige opgaver. Hvilke opgaver du helt nøjagtig vil komme til at arbejde med, afhænger af, hvilken afdeling du bliver en del af:

**Din første arbejdsdag:** d. 1. september 2027, hvor du starter med alle dine med-graduates på samme årgang. Hvis du gerne vil starte som studentermedhjælper før, kan vi også vende denne mulighed undervejs.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Become a Tax & Legal Graduate at PwC and step into the role of a consultant**

*Would you like to explore tax law, finance, and legal topics? And do you want to see how both large and small companies across Denmark operate?*

Become a graduate at PwC and jump straight into the role of consultant. Over the next 2 years, you will develop your professional toolbox, continuously gain more responsibility while working on projects, and build close relationships with clients and colleagues.

**We empower you to take the lead from day one**

Your graduate programme begins on September 1, 2027, where you will join a team of 300 colleagues in our Tax & Legal organisation. You will be employed in one of our 8 departments, and over the next 2 years, we will prepare you for the role of a consultant through knowledge sharing, courses and practical experience.

Initially, you and the other graduates will get to know each other, and you will receive a thorough introduction to our company and the tasks awaiting you. You will also be given a career coach who will support you – this continues after the graduate programme when you continue your career at PwC.

*“The graduate programme provides an excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth. You get involved in exciting projects, work on complex challenges, and take on responsibility early on, making every day both rewarding and motivating,”* says Kristina, Shipping, Oil & Energy.

**Act as a consultant on financial, economic, and legal tasks**

In Tax & Legal, we help clients in the Danish business community across a wide range of legal areas and nearly all aspects of tax law. You can look forward to tackling a variety of different tasks. The exact tasks you will work on depend on which department you become part of:

* Compliance & Wealth – working at the intersection of corporate and personal tax.
* Deals Tax – working with private equity clients and M&A transactions.
* Indirect Taxes – working with VAT, customs, and excise duties.
* Business Tax – working with corporate tax, restructuring, succession planning, and property tax.
* International Tax Services - working with international tax matters for Danish and multinational corporations, as well as foundations, private equity, and financial companies.
* Transfer Pricing – working with multinational companies' cross-border transactions.
* Shipping, Oil & Energy (only in Hellerup) – working with energy, oil, and shipping companies.
* Legal – working with corporate and commercial law as well as M&A.

As a consultant, you will work very independently, but we solve tasks in teams, so you will also work with colleagues from other areas within PwC.

In Tax & Legal, artificial intelligence is an integral part of the way we work. We use AI to support and streamline work processes, analyse large volumes of data, and create even greater value for our clients. As a graduate with us, you will have the opportunity to work with modern AI tools and help shape the future of tax and legal advisory services.

**A strong community and great colleagues who become friends**

In Tax & Legal, we combine our expertise with a strong sense of community. We believe the best results are created through collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous sparring with colleagues.

You will be given responsibility early in your career, but you will never be on your own. Whether you are working on client engagements or internal projects, you will always be surrounded by experienced colleagues who support and challenge you, helping you grow both professionally and personally.

At the same time, you will become part of PwC’s graduate community across the firm, taking part in onboarding activities, networking events, and professional development programmes alongside fellow graduates.

**Are you about to finish your master’s degree and ready to kick-start your career?**

As long as you (are about to) hold a master's degree in business law, law, or economics and are prepared for a steep learning curve, we will ensure you are well-equipped for the rest.

What matters most is your curiosity, both about our clients and the challenges you take on. Alongside a proactive mindset and strong relationship-building skills, we look for a genuine eagerness to learn and grow, both professionally and personally. We value people who view every assignment as an opportunity to develop and who understand that the best results are achieved through teamwork.

**Ready to kickstart your career?**

…then apply via the link. If you have questions, feel free to contact Helena Fjord at helena.holmberg.fjord@pwc.com.

**Job Description & Summary**

*Kunne du tænke dig at træde ind i rollen som konsulent og arbejde med virksomhedsopkøb, frasalg og integrationer? Og vil du samtidig lære, hvordan virksomheder og investorer skaber værdi før, under og efter en transaktion?*

Så bliv graduate i PwC’s Deals Carve-out & Merger Integration team (Delivering Deal Value) og vær med til at rådgive virksomheder gennem nogle af deres mest komplekse forandringer. Her får du et væld af muligheder, et højt fagligt niveau og et stærkt fællesskab, som sikrer, at du udvikler dig fagligt og personligt. Du vil opnå erfaring på tværs af forskellige forretningsområder, hvilket giver dig en bred forståelse af de relevante processer i forbindelse med virksomhedstransaktioner.

**Din udvikling er supporteret af PwC’s graduateprogram**

Den 1. september 2027 starter dit 2-årige graduateforløb i vores Deals-afdeling. Her starter du og de andre graduates ud med en grundig introduktion til PwC, teamet og de opgaver, der venter dig. Som graduate bliver du fastansat i afdelingen, og vi sørger for at klæde dig godt på til rollen som konsulent gennem videndeling, skræddersyede kursusprogrammer og praktisk erfaring.

Som en del af graduateprogramment sikrer vi også, at I bliver rystet godt sammen på jeres onboarding-tur, til netværksevents samt på opgaver - både internt i Deals og på tværs af huset.

**Arbejdet i PwC Deals**

Som graduate i Deals bliver du en del af en ung og dynamisk afdeling på mere end 110 dygtige kolleger. Her kommer du til at arbejde med flere aspekter af virksomhedsopkøb og -salg og lærer samtidig, hvordan du kan bidrage med værdifuld rådgivning til beslutningstagere i både private equity fonde og virksomheder.

PwC Deals består primært af tre forskellige fagområder, som du vælger på forhånd og bliver i forløbet igennem: Transaction Services, Valuation and Modelling samt Delivering Deal Value. Hvert fagområde håndterer interaktioner med sælgere, købere og andre potentielle stakeholders afhængigt af transaktionens fase, kompleksitet og de behov, der opstår undervejs i processen.

**Lige nu er der kun åbent for ansøgere i vores Delivering Deal Value-team.** Er du interesseret i at søge til Transaction Services eller Valuation & Modelling, kan du søge til januar/februar, hvor de går live med deres opslag:

* **Delivering Deal Value:** Få hands-on erfaring med nogle af de største og mest komplekse M&A-transaktioner på det danske marked. Vi hjælper virksomheder og private equity-fonde med at planlægge og gennemføre integrationer og carve-outs, så de realiserer værdien af deres transaktioner. Du bliver involveret i projekter, der spænder fra carve-out due diligence til Day 1-forberedelser og eksekvering af integrations- og separationsprogrammer. Undervejs får du indblik i, hvordan virksomheder integreres, adskilles og transformeres som en del af M&A-transaktioner.

**Et godt fællesskab og gode kolleger**

Hos PwC bliver du en del af en markedsledende virksomhed, hvor vi gør tingene ordentligt. Her får du mulighed for at træde ind i et powerhouse af viden, som du får rig mulighed for at suge til dig.

PwC Deals er en af Danmarks førende M&A-rådgivere, hvor vi kombinerer ekspertise med et stærkt fællesskab. Som en del af vores team får du ikke kun mulighed for at arbejde med nogle af de mest spændende og komplekse transaktioner, men også at udvikle dig i et miljø præget af samarbejde og fælles ambitioner.

Samtidig får du din egen career coach, som du kan sparre med - også når du fortsætter din karriere i PwC efter forløbet.

Teamwork er en kerneværdi hos os, og du kan se frem til at arbejde sammen med fantastiske kolleger i dit nye team. Samtidig bliver du en del af et større fællesskab med graduates fra hele PwC, som du kommer til at kende godt gennem de events, vi løbende inviterer dig til.

**Er du ved at afslutte din kandidat og klar til næste skridt?**

Så længe du (snart) har en relevant kandidatuddannelse, fx cand.merc.FIR, FIN, FSM, cand.polit., cand.oecon. eller lignende, og er klar på at lære en masse, klæder vi dig godt på til resten.

Hos os kommer man langt med nysgerrighed - både over for dine nye kolleger, opgaver og vores kunder. Men det er også vigtigt, at du er opsøgende, god til at opbygge relationer og ser opgaveløsningen som en holdindsats. Samtidig trives du i en omskiftelig hverdag, og du har lyst til konsulentrollen på sigt.

**Klar til at kickstarte din karriere?**

…så ansøg via linket. Hvis du har spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Talent Attraction Advisor, Helena Holmberg Fjord på helena.holmberg.fjord@pwc.com.

**Ansøgningsfrist:** 18. oktober. Vi screener løbende – så søg hellere i dag end i morgen!

* Upload en motiveret ansøgning

*Brænder du for at skabe succes sammen med andre? Som employer branding-praktikant får du en unik mulighed for at bygge bro mellem studerende og PwC. Du får samtidig praktisk erfaring fra en HR-afdeling, hvor du bliver en del af et fællesskab, hvor vi sparrer og deler idéer.*

**Hverdagen som employer branding-praktikant i PwC’s Human Capital-afdeling**

Du bliver en del af vores Talent Attraction-team, som til dagligt arbejder med tiltrækning og rekruttering, herunder employer branding. Vi er ni engagerede kollegaer, der samarbejder tæt og har en uformel, inkluderende kultur med plads til både faglig sparring og grin i hverdagen.

Rollen som praktikant giver dig en bred kontaktflade i organisationen, hvor du samarbejder med kollegaer på tværs af PwC samt eksterne samarbejdspartnere. Du får derfor et stærkt netværk og værdifuld indsigt i, hvordan vi arbejder strategisk med talenttiltrækning.

**Dine daglige opgaver i Talent Attraction-teamet**

Dine arbejdsopgaver bliver især at planlægge, udvikle, afholde og evaluere employer branding-arrangementer. Du er med i hele processen bag et event - fra det første planlægningsmøde til følelsen efter et succesfuldt event. I det daglige:

* Assisterer du dine kollegaer i ifm. employer branding events, hvilket kan indebære; pakning af materialer, booking af lokaler, bestilling af transport og forplejning, sikre at lageret er opdateret samt opdatering af vores interne oversigter.
* Er du i dialog med relevante stakeholders - både kollegaer i PwC og eksterne samarbejdspartnere.
* Sørger du for opsætning, klargøring og oprydning af lokaler, hvor PwC afholder events, samt er med ude på messer på de forskellige uddannelsesinstitutioner.

**Har du sans for Powerpoint eller Google Slides?**

Vi søger dig, der er i gang med en videregående uddannelse og gerne vil have “jord under neglene” i et praktikforløb hos os. Vi er åbne over for praktikanter fra forskellige uddannelsesretninger, blot du:

* Høj sans for detaljer, og tænker både i overblik, strukturer og processer
* Har kendskab til Microsoft-pakken, især PowerPoint

Som praktikant arbejder du som udgangspunkt 30 timer om ugen, og vi tilpasser selvfølgelig i forhold til dit studie. Praktikken er ulønnet, men vi garanterer, at du får masser af erfaring i rygsækken.

**Job Description & Summary**

Er du klar til at få hands-on erfaring med kompetenceudvikling, HR og alsidig kursusadministration i en af Danmarks største vidensorganisationer?

Som praktikant hos PwC får du ansvar fra dag ét, arbejder bredt på tværs af projekter og får mulighed for at sætte dit personlige præg på både din egen hverdag og vores processer. Stillingen kan være på 4-6 måneder og mellem 30-37 timer - afhængig af dit studie.

”*Hos os er du ikke kun en hjælper i kulissen – du er en fuldgyldig del af teamet fra første dag. Så vi håber, at du vil dele din viden med os, ligesom vi er klar til at lære dig en masse,”* fortæller Development Advisor Anna Juncker Madsen.

**Velkommen til HR Development – hvor fællesskab og faglighed går hånd i hånd**

PwC er et af landets (og verdens) største revisions- og konsulenthuse. I Danmark er vi ca. 3.000 medarbejdere, fordelt på 9 lokationer landet over.

På vores kontor i Hellerup bliver du en del af vores Human Capital-afdeling og mere specifikt HR Development, hvor der står 11 engagerede kolleger klar til at byde dig velkommen. Vi arbejder på tværs af vores organisation og tæt sammen med resten af afdelingen om at sikre, at vi fastholder og konstant udvikler det, der er det helt særlige ved PwC – nemlig viden.

*”Her er der plads til både de store ambitioner, konstruktiv vidensdeling, et godt fællesskab – og dårlig humor hen over skrivebordet,”* fortsætter Anna.

Vi aftaler dine mødetider nærmere, når du starter, men vi har god fleksibilitet. For vi fokuserer mere på din indstilling, tilgang og resultater end på, hvornår du præcis sidder på din kontorstol.

**Dyk ned i kompetenceudvikling, trivsel og HR**

Som praktikant hos os bliver du en aktiv del af, hvordan vi udvikler PwC’s lærings- og udviklingsmiljø. Du kommer til at arbejde på tværs og snuse til forskellige områder og får selvfølgelig en grundig onboarding og masser af ansvar, så snart du føler dig klar til det – men vi er altid tæt på til at spare med og samle op.

Du kommer fx til at:

* støtte op om planlægning og afvikling af kurser på tværs af hele PwC
* deltage i konceptudvikling af workshops om fx psykologisk tryghed, ledelse eller læringsteori, som vi skræddersyr efter behov for forskellige afdelinger
* udarbejde præsentationer, materialer og oplæg i tæt samarbejde med erfarne kolleger
* være med til at drive mindre projekter inden for kompetenceudvikling og intern rådgivning
* deltage på teammøder og samarbejder direkte med forretningsenheder og interne stakeholders.

*”Jo mere nysgerrighed og engagement, du tager med på arbejde, jo mere kan du få lov til at præge - både hvad angår din egen rolle og vores processer,”* uddyber Anna.

**Nysgerrig, nytænkende og klar på ansvar**

Du er typen, der stiller de gode spørgsmål, byder ind med idéer og tør tage ansvar, før nogen beder dig om det. Og så har du solide kommunikationsevner – både på skrift og ansigt til ansigt, så du let kan begå dig i en kompleks organisation. Samtidig evner du både at arbejde selvstændigt og som en del af et team.

Vi forestiller os derudover, at du:

* er i gang med en relevant kandidatuddannelse – eller er på sidste del af din bachelor
* er på en uddannelse, hvor du beskæftiger dig med fx HR, organisation, læring, kommunikation eller lignende – det vigtigste er dog din motivation, din lyst til at lære og din evne til at omsætte teori til praksis
* har stærke sproglige kompetencer på både dansk og engelsk
* tør tænke lidt ud af boksen, udfordre idéer og byde aktivt ind med input og forbedringer.

For at få mest ud af praktikforløbet er det vigtigt, at du kan være en del af teamet minimum 4 dage om ugen.

**Grow here. Go further.**

Som en del af PwC er du både en del af en markedssucces og et sted, der er rart at være. Det er i samspillet mellem de to, tilliden opstår, du lærer nyt og udvikler dig. Sammen med dine kolleger er du med til at skabe innovative løsninger for erhvervslivet og det samfund, vi alle er en del af.

**Vil du være en del af vores stærke fællesskab?**

Hvis du er blevet nysgerrig på jobbet eller har nogle spørgsmål, er du også mere end velkommen til at ringe eller skrive til Development Advisor Anna Juncker Madsen på anna.juncker.madsen@pwc.com eller +45 23 41 10 96.

**Ansøgningsfrist**: Send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt, da vi screener og indkalder til samtaler løbende. Vi tager opslaget ned, når vores nye kollega er fundet.
